art_direction: 乌黑长发女性在茉莉庭院茶桌旁斟茶，白色衬衫和浅青长裙显得清爽宁静。
composition_variation: Create an original premium 2D anime wallpaper of exactly one woman, visibly 29 years old, with long soft black hair loosely knotted at the nape, with a few fine strands falling naturally. She has mature, self-assured elegance and realistic adult proportions. Give her deep brown eyes, a smooth adult face with subtle cheekbone definition, and an attentive, welcoming smile. She wears an opaque white linen blouse with short puff sleeves and a modest round neckline, paired with a pale-aqua ankle-length skirt. Seated upright at a small courtyard table, she carefully pours tea from a compact celadon pot into one matching cup, with both hands close together. Jasmine vines frame the lower sides, and pale stone walls provide spacious simplicity. Morning sunlight filters through leaves, creating warm highlights and cool mint shadows. Include only one cup, a tiny dish, and a folded napkin. Frame at eye level for a very tall phone crop. Keep her face, body, and hands inside the central narrow column, in the middle and lower image; leave the upper 25% calm and mostly empty for the clock. Natural nonsexual posture, opaque summer clothing, graceful anatomy, small readable hands close to her body. Refined linework, layered cel shading, painterly light, no text, logos, other people, or copied characters.
